# MCP tools

Each contract is one MCP tool, named by its tag, as `tools/list` shows it over `/mcp` and over stdio from `myr mcp`. A tool's input is the contract's payload and its output is the contract's success. A refusal comes back as the tool's error result: the refusal as JSON, `_tag` and all (see [refusals.md](refusals.md)).

The hints come from each contract's own annotations. No tool reaches anything outside the platform, so `openWorldHint` is always false.

## listAsks

List a project's open asks.

| Hint | Value |
| --- | --- |
| `destructiveHint` | `false` |
| `idempotentHint` | `true` |
| `openWorldHint` | `false` |
| `readOnlyHint` | `true` |

### Input

```json
{
  "additionalProperties": true,
  "properties": {
    "project": {
      "pattern": "^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$",
      "type": "string"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "project"
  ],
  "type": "object"
}
```

### Output

```json
{
  "additionalProperties": true,
  "properties": {
    "asks": {
      "items": {
        "additionalProperties": true,
        "properties": {
          "ask": {
            "pattern": "^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$",
            "type": "string"
          },
          "claimed": {
            "type": "boolean"
          },
          "territory": {
            "minLength": 1,
            "type": "string"
          },
          "want": {
            "minLength": 1,
            "type": "string"
          }
        },
        "required": [
          "ask",
          "claimed",
          "territory",
          "want"
        ],
        "type": "object"
      },
      "type": "array"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "asks"
  ],
  "type": "object"
}
```

## submitAnswer

Offer the commit `head`, built on `base`, as an answer to an ask; once it lands, `main` is the new tip.

| Hint | Value |
| --- | --- |
| `destructiveHint` | `false` |
| `idempotentHint` | `true` |
| `openWorldHint` | `false` |
| `readOnlyHint` | `false` |

### Input

```json
{
  "additionalProperties": true,
  "properties": {
    "ask": {
      "pattern": "^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "base": {
      "pattern": "^[0-9a-f]{40}$",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "head": {
      "pattern": "^[0-9a-f]{40}$",
      "type": "string"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "ask",
    "base",
    "head"
  ],
  "type": "object"
}
```

### Output

```json
{
  "additionalProperties": true,
  "properties": {
    "main": {
      "pattern": "^[0-9a-f]{40}$",
      "type": "string"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "main"
  ],
  "type": "object"
}
```
